title: A woman has a man made entirely of wicker built to be her husband and...
transcript: the second I saw the trailer for Wicker I knew I had to see this movie a weird maybe freaky romance about a woman falling in love with a man made of Wicker yes please and luckily my friend Nicole agreed because it was her birthday and she wanted to get a bunch of her friends to watch Wicker together in theaters and I was more than happy to you can't really tell here but Nicole has an AMC themed dress on it has the entire Nicole Kidman speech I am obsessed with it anyway this was the best way to watch this movie in a big group because Wicker really was a delightful quirky and sometimes flat out bizarre small town romance and everything I wanted it to be Olivia Coleman plays a fisherwoman who lives in a vaguely I don't know medieval village town has very specific traditions and expectations for women and the fisherwoman defies all of it she's independent she says what she thinks but she's also an outcast and the town's people have decided that she's entire hourly undesirable so as a way to stick it to them and also cause maybe she's a little bit lonely she goes to the basket weaver and asks him to build her a husband and he does and unlike all of the mediocre to downright terrible men of the village the wicker husband is caring and attentive and emotionally vulnerable and leaves her extremely actually satisfied and I know you're all wondering how does wicker anatomy work it never explains it and honestly it doesn't matter what does matter is that this is an incredibly beautiful love story about a woman who's been rejected by society who doesn't fit into traditional beauty standards and waits to marry the right man who doesn't want to control her who doesn't want to anger who just wants to love her and make her happy and that is the most radical thing this village has ever seen also just like in general I think we've normalized relationships where women are expected to give so much to the point that when a woman is just loved unconditionally it really starts to feel like a fantasy whether the man is made of flesh and blood or wicker anyway I really enjoyed this movie yes it is a bit absurd and requires a ridiculous suspension of disbelief but I was fully in it it's also just a very very funny movie and yes romantic and sexy and surprisingly moving thanks Nicole for planning the most perfect birthday outing ever
